notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone ! 

Here are some new fixes : 

[spoiler]The Earth Elementary equipment which give him extra toughness should work properly[/spoiler]
[spoiler]The Werewolf animations should normally trigger only when he's morphing[/spoiler]
You should be able to quit and reload your game normally !

We are aware that some of you may have a crash after winning a boss fight, we are still investigating on this problem and will come back to you with a fix as soon as possible. Thanks a lot for your patience and thank you so much for your feedbacks which help us fixing the game !

Hope you're enjoying Perfect Teams !

notes.title: Window Mode
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

With this hotfix you should be able to toggle a window mode (locked in 1920x1080). We have also added black borders if you play with a wider resolution in full screen mode.

We are aware this not a perfect solution, but the game should be more playable while we are working on better solutions.

We hope you're having a good time playing Perfect Teams !

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone ! 

Small issues fixed here :

[spoiler]The werewolf should correctly morph into his beast form (and stay in it)[/spoiler]
[spoiler]Cowgirl's cards shouln't disappear if you try to play them without bullets[/spoiler]

We hope you are enjoying playing Perfect Teams !

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone ! 

A small hotfix to fix a fight that can softlock your games :

-The elite fight with the prison keeper, his dog and a rat should no longer crash
-The druidess' card "Peel" has been fixed and should correctly give the alteration to the druidess.

Thanks a lot for your feedbacks and we hope you are enjoying playing Perfect Teams !

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone ! 

We fixed the most urgent bug and provide a few QoL improvements :
-Cards should no longer move at the bottom of your screen
-Mouse over pop-up should no longer be hidden by cards
-Shop UI has been fixed
-Minor text fixes

We hope you enjoy trying to figure out what is your perfect team !
